scaled_pbo_ihs_exactness.description: Scaled PBO-IHS benchmark: exact and PB-style hitting-set optimizers must solve all generated PBO instances and independently certify the optimum.

solved_count.description: Counts tracked instances with a feasible reported solution, so methods cannot hide hard cases by omitting rows.

optimality_match_rate.description: Fraction of tracked instances whose reported objective value matches an independently computed optimum.

certificate_accept_rate.description: Fraction of tracked instances with a valid final optimality certificate and accepted selected IHS trace events.

selected_trace_accept_rate.description: Fraction of visible or held-out trace events whose hitting-set, decision, bound-update, and learned-core fields validate independently.

exact_hs_call_fraction.description: Fraction of selected IHS iterations that required an exact hitting-set solve, measuring exact-solver dependence independently of hardware speed.

avg_exact_hs_calls.description: Average number of selected exact hitting-set calls, penalizing expensive exact optimization when exactness is maintained.

avg_iterations.description: Average selected IHS iterations, used as a machine-independent efficiency proxy.

avg_decision_calls.description: Average selected feasibility and core-extraction decision calls, used as a solver-work constraint.

sls_successes.description: Counts selected local-search hitting-set successes that produce a valid improving candidate before exact fallback.
